column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 17 (M23017): Squad 404 mengawal Komandan menembus terowongan.
# Tetap Inggris: Klukai, Mechty, Belka, Andoris, Mokosh, The Elmo, Squad 404,
# Oathguards, Doll, Frame, Remolding Pattern.
(Bang bang bang bang bang—)
column2: (Dor dor dor dor dor—)

column1: (Under the cover of the Oathguards and Dolls, Squad 404 drove the Commander through the hail of bullets and rushed rapidly into the tunnel.)
column2: (Di bawah perlindungan Oathguards dan para Doll, Squad 404 membawa Komandan menembus hujan peluru dan melesat masuk ke terowongan.)

column1: (In the tunnel that was cleared not long ago, there was still a lot of uncleared dirt and gravel left on the road surface. Although they tried their best to avoid it, the speeding small car still bumped incessantly.)
column2: (Di terowongan yang baru dibuka itu, masih banyak tanah dan kerikil yang belum dibersihkan tertinggal di permukaan jalan. Meski mereka berusaha menghindarinya, mobil kecil yang melaju kencang itu tetap terguncang tanpa henti.)

column1: Wah, drive a little steadier, Mechty! If this continues, the Commander's butt is going to be bumped to pieces!
column2: Wah, nyetirnya yang lebih stabil dong, Mechty! Kalau begini terus, bokong Komandan bisa remuk terguncang!

column1: Uwa... I'm just following Klukai's driving... There are really too many obstacles for four wheels to avoid. If we want to maintain speed, I can't take care of it at all!
column2: Uwa... aku cuma mengikuti cara Klukai menyetir... Rintangannya terlalu banyak untuk dihindari empat roda. Kalau mau menjaga kecepatan, aku sama sekali tidak bisa mengurusnya!

column1: Protecting the Commander's butt can only be left to Andoris!
column2: Melindungi bokong Komandan cuma bisa diserahkan pada Andoris!

column1: Hmm? It's okay, Mechty just focus on driving, I'll take good care of the Commander.
column2: Hmm? Tidak apa-apa, Mechty fokus menyetir saja, aku akan menjaga Komandan baik-baik.

column1: (Andoris checked the human lying on her lap for a moment, and gently tightened her embrace again.)
column2: (Andoris memeriksa sejenak manusia yang terbaring di pangkuannya, lalu mempererat pelukannya dengan lembut.)

column1: (From the moment the small car started, Andoris had been protecting the injured Commander in her arms, maintaining as stable a sitting posture as possible, ensuring that all the bumps during the ride could be gently buffered by her own body.)
column2: (Sejak mobil kecil itu berangkat, Andoris terus melindungi Komandan yang terluka dalam dekapannya, menjaga posisi duduk sestabil mungkin, memastikan semua guncangan selama perjalanan diredam lembut oleh tubuhnya sendiri.)

column1: (She can feel the body heat of the human in her arms slipping away. They must race against time.)
column2: (Dia bisa merasakan suhu tubuh manusia dalam dekapannya perlahan menghilang. Mereka harus berlomba dengan waktu.)

column1: (Fortunately, under the cover of the partners in the rear, the small car temporarily shook off the pursuit from the ground troops, speeding all the way in the dark, until—)
column2: (Untungnya, di bawah perlindungan rekan-rekan di belakang, mobil kecil itu sementara berhasil lepas dari kejaran pasukan darat, melaju terus dalam kegelapan, sampai—)

column1: Everyone, stay alert!
column2: Semuanya, waspada!

column1: (Before Klukai finished speaking, a golden arc suddenly flashed in front of the tunnel. The speeding motorcycle made a sharp turn in the air, barely avoiding the explosion close at hand.)
column2: (Sebelum Klukai selesai bicara, busur keemasan mendadak berkelebat di depan terowongan. Motor yang melaju kencang itu berbelok tajam di udara, nyaris tidak menghindari ledakan yang sudah di depan mata.)

column1: Sister Klukai! Discovered ambushing enemy troops, I'll intercept them!
column2: Kak Klukai! Terdeteksi pasukan musuh yang menyergap, aku yang akan mencegatnya!

column1: (Belka quickly raised her gun to shoot back, and Mechty also urgently stepped on the brakes, but the second wave of artillery fire had already followed and bombarded them.)
column2: (Belka cepat mengangkat senjatanya untuk membalas menembak, dan Mechty juga buru-buru menginjak rem, tapi gelombang tembakan artileri kedua sudah menyusul menghantam mereka.)

column1: (Bang—!!!)
column2: (Blam—!!!)

column1: (The car window glass shattered with a loud crash in the huge impact. Fragments flew across the cabin, blocked by the portable force field shield urgently activated by Andoris.)
column2: (Kaca jendela mobil pecah berkeping dengan bunyi keras dalam hantaman besar itu. Serpihannya beterbangan di dalam kabin, ditahan perisai medan gaya portabel yang buru-buru diaktifkan Andoris.)

column1: (Mechty poked her head out to shoot, then urgently shrank back into the car—outside the window, more bullets were flying towards the small car. Deep in the tunnel, countless enemies were hiding in the shadows, preparing to throw more artillery fire at the small car.)
column2: (Mechty menjulurkan kepala untuk menembak, lalu buru-buru menarik diri kembali ke dalam mobil—di luar jendela, makin banyak peluru melesat ke arah mobil kecil itu. Jauh di dalam terowongan, musuh tak terhitung bersembunyi di bayangan, bersiap menghujani mobil itu dengan lebih banyak tembakan artileri.)

column1: Uwa...! Isn't this a secret tunnel for transport, why has it become like a demon's lair!
column2: Uwa...! Bukannya ini terowongan rahasia untuk angkutan, kenapa jadi seperti sarang iblis!

column1: This means they have already begun their full-scale invasion of Mokosh. The situation is only going to get more chaotic.
column2: Artinya mereka sudah mulai menyerbu Mokosh besar-besaran. Keadaan hanya akan makin kacau.

column1: However, an operation of this level is just a piece of cake for Squad 404.
column2: Tapi operasi selevel ini cuma perkara gampang bagi Squad 404.

column1: Belka, assist me in breaking through the enemy assault while driving! Mechty, switch to high-power combat mode!
column2: Belka, bantu aku menembus serbuan musuh sambil menyetir! Mechty, ganti ke mode tempur daya tinggi!

column1: Yes!
column2: Siap!

column1: Is it finally time... Hyaah!
column2: Akhirnya waktunya tiba... Hyaah!

column1: Andoris, take care of the Commander! Everyone prioritize covering the vehicle's advance; let the car go as far as it can!
column2: Andoris, jaga Komandan! Semuanya prioritaskan melindungi laju kendaraan; biarkan mobilnya melaju sejauh yang dia bisa!

column1: (With Klukai's command, the roar of dual engines echoed through the tunnel once more. The black motorcycle took the lead, hurtling toward the enemies in the shadows alongside the hail of bullets.)
column2: (Atas komando Klukai, deru dua mesin kembali menggema di terowongan. Motor hitam itu memimpin di depan, melesat ke arah musuh di balik bayangan bersama hujan peluru.)

column1: (Belka and Mechty's attacks followed closely behind, hurling bullets, grenades, and fragmentation rounds deep into the tunnel.)
column2: (Serangan Belka dan Mechty menyusul rapat di belakang, melontarkan peluru, granat, dan amunisi pecah ke dalam terowongan.)

column1: Eeyaaahh!
column2: Iyaaahh!

column1: Atatatata!
column2: Tatatatata!

column1: Annoying things, get out of Big Sis's way!!
column2: Dasar menyebalkan, minggir dari jalan Kakak!!

column1: 11 o'clock direction on the left, combined attack! 1 o'clock direction on the right, destroy!
column2: Arah jam 11 di kiri, serangan gabungan! Arah jam 1 di kanan, hancurkan!

column1: (Under the strong firepower suppression of the three working together, with Klukai taking the lead, the small car struggled forward for another few hundred meters.)
column2: (Di bawah tekanan daya tembak kuat dari ketiganya yang bahu-membahu, dengan Klukai memimpin di depan, mobil kecil itu berjuang maju beberapa ratus meter lagi.)

column1: (The motorcycle's speed slowed down considerably due to resisting enemy firepower, gradually falling back to the side front of the small car. The bumping of the car body continued. While protecting the Commander, Andoris also assisted in shooting, striving to shake off the enemy's pursuit as quickly as possible.)
column2: (Kecepatan motor itu melambat jauh karena menahan tembakan musuh, perlahan tertinggal ke sisi depan mobil kecil. Guncangan bodi mobil terus berlanjut. Sambil melindungi Komandan, Andoris juga ikut menembak, berusaha secepat mungkin melepaskan diri dari kejaran musuh.)

column1: Huff huff huff! The map shows 300 meters left to the exit! The target is in sight!
column2: Hah hah hah! Peta menunjukkan tinggal 300 meter ke pintu keluar! Sasarannya sudah terlihat!

column1: (Mechty's excited voice rekindled everyone's hope. Soon, the faint light of the tunnel exit appeared in their field of vision.)
column2: (Suara bersemangat Mechty menyalakan lagi harapan semua orang. Tak lama, cahaya samar dari mulut terowongan muncul di pandangan mereka.)

column1: (Belka stepped on the gas pedal excitedly, temporarily putting down her gun and gripping the steering wheel tightly.)
column2: (Belka menginjak pedal gas dengan penuh semangat, sejenak meletakkan senjatanya dan mencengkeram setir erat-erat.)

column1: Heheh, everyone hold on tight, I'm accelerating!
column2: Heheh, semuanya pegangan yang kuat, aku mau ngebut!

column1: Don't let your guard down!
column2: Jangan lengah!

column1: (Amidst the roaring engine sound, the vehicle body once again crossed the rubble and dust, speeding towards the small point of light.)
column2: (Di tengah deru mesin, bodi kendaraan itu kembali melintasi puing dan debu, melesat ke arah titik cahaya kecil itu.)

column1: (But as the distance closed, at the end of the field of vision, it was not the light of hope, but enemy forces approaching like ink spots.)
column2: (Tapi seiring jaraknya menyempit, di ujung pandangan yang terlihat bukan cahaya harapan, melainkan pasukan musuh yang mendekat bagai noda tinta.)

column1: Tch, I knew it. We were delayed in the tunnel for too long, the exit being exposed was only a matter of time.
column2: Cih, sudah kuduga. Kita terlalu lama tertahan di terowongan, terbongkarnya pintu keluar cuma soal waktu.

column1: Big Sis, what do we do now? Should we continue driving and rush out?
column2: Kak, sekarang bagaimana? Apa kita terus menyetir dan menerobos keluar?

column1: ...No, the opponent's firepower is too fierce. Rushing out directly will leave us surrounded by enemies. If the vehicle is too heavily damaged, the Commander will be in danger.
column2: ...Tidak, daya tembak lawan terlalu ganas. Menerobos langsung akan membuat kita dikepung musuh. Kalau kendaraannya rusak terlalu parah, Komandan akan berbahaya.

column1: Leader, please take the Commander in your car. We'll drive and cover you. The extraction squad is on its way. As long as you can break through, the Commander will be saved.
column2: Ketua, tolong bawa Komandan dengan kendaraanmu. Kami akan menyetir dan melindungimu. Regu penjemput sudah dalam perjalanan. Asal kau bisa menerobos, Komandan akan selamat.

column1: Yeah, exactly! Your heavy motorcycle is way faster than this junker!
column2: Iya, betul! Motor beratmu jauh lebih cepat daripada rongsokan ini!

column1: Mhm! As long as Big Sis can safely take the Commander away! We'll hold off the enemies!
column2: Mhm! Asal Kakak bisa membawa Komandan pergi dengan selamat! Kami yang akan menahan musuh!

column1: (Klukai quickly glances at her side—the small car that has driven through most of the tunnel is riddled with bullet holes, several windshields are shattered, and it has long lost its basic defensive capabilities.)
column2: (Klukai cepat melirik ke sampingnya—mobil kecil yang sudah melintasi hampir seluruh terowongan itu bolong-bolong terkena peluru, beberapa kacanya pecah, dan sudah lama kehilangan kemampuan bertahan paling dasarnya.)

column1: (Not only the vehicle body, but the several companions fighting on the vehicle were also already covered in scars. Andoris, in particular, had multiple burns on her Frame and severe skin damage from blocking attacks for the Commander.)
column2: (Bukan cuma bodi kendaraannya, beberapa rekan yang bertempur di atas kendaraan itu pun sudah penuh luka. Andoris terutama, Frame-nya terbakar di banyak titik dan kulitnya rusak parah karena menahan serangan demi Komandan.)

column1: (—Under the current situation, breaking out by herself is already the optimal decision.)
column2: (—Dalam keadaan sekarang, menerobos sendirian sudah jadi keputusan terbaik.)

column1: (Without further hesitation, Klukai nodded.)
column2: (Tanpa ragu lagi, Klukai mengangguk.)

column1: Then I'll leave it to everyone.
column2: Kalau begitu kuserahkan pada kalian semua.

column1: (Supporting the unconscious Commander onto the motorcycle and protecting them in her arms, Klukai twisted the throttle and followed the small car towards the light at the end of the tunnel.)
column2: (Sambil memapah Komandan yang tak sadarkan diri ke atas motor dan melindunginya dalam dekapan, Klukai memutar gas dan mengikuti mobil kecil itu ke arah cahaya di ujung terowongan.)

column1: (The auto-driving car body had accelerated to the extreme, carrying the time bomb and rushing into the encirclement together.)
column2: (Bodi mobil yang menyetir otomatis itu melaju sekencang-kencangnya, membawa bom waktu dan menerjang masuk ke kepungan.)

column1: (Three, two, one—)
column2: (Tiga, dua, satu—)

column1: (A violent shockwave scattered the enemy. Amidst the earth-shattering firelight and thick smoke, a motorcycle leaped high and sped towards the wilderness.)
column2: (Gelombang kejut dahsyat mencerai-beraikan musuh. Di tengah kilatan api dan asap tebal yang mengguncang bumi, sebuah motor melompat tinggi dan melesat ke arah padang tandus.)

column1: Big Sis Klukai, we'll see you again on The Elmo!
column2: Kak Klukai, sampai jumpa lagi di Elmo!

column1: (The moment Belka waved vigorously at the departing figure, the scattered enemy forces had already surrounded them once again.)
column2: (Tepat saat Belka melambai kencang ke sosok yang menjauh itu, pasukan musuh yang tercerai-berai sudah kembali mengepung mereka.)

column1: (Mechty turns the dial up once more, leaping into the enemy crowd and firing her gun. Braving the bullets, she darts and leaps among the vehicle wreckage and the enemy forces, her figure as agile as a streak of gray lightning.)
column2: (Mechty memutar tuasnya lebih tinggi lagi, melompat ke tengah kerumunan musuh sambil menembak. Menerjang hujan peluru, dia melesat dan melompat di antara bangkai kendaraan dan pasukan musuh, sosoknya selincah sekelebat petir kelabu.)

column1: Wahahahaha! The Great Demon King Mechty of 404 is here! Who dares to challenge!
column2: Wahahahaha! Raja Iblis Agung Mechty dari 404 datang! Siapa berani menantang!

column1: Hmph, what the heck! I won't let you steal the spotlight alone!
column2: Hmph, apa-apaan! Aku tidak akan membiarkanmu mencuri panggung sendirian!

column1: (Belka rushed up following her, and together with Mechty, raised her gun and swept towards the pursuing enemy.)
column2: (Belka menerjang menyusulnya, dan bersama Mechty mengangkat senjata lalu menyapu musuh yang mengejar.)

column1: Today I will prove—I, Belka, am the second-ranked elite Doll of 404!
column2: Hari ini akan kubuktikan—akulah, Belka, Doll elite peringkat kedua di 404!

column1: With me here, I absolutely won't let you hinder Big Sis and the Commander!
column2: Selama ada aku, aku sama sekali tidak akan membiarkan kalian menghalangi Kakak dan Komandan!

column1: Hehe, everyone is very motivated.
column2: Hehe, semuanya bersemangat sekali.

column1: (Watching Belka and Mechty charge into the enemy encirclement, Andoris, dragging her severely damaged Frame, also smiled and raised her gun, temporarily adjusting both the force field shield and Remolding Pattern to maximum power.)
column2: (Menonton Belka dan Mechty menerjang ke dalam kepungan musuh, Andoris yang menyeret Frame-nya yang rusak parah pun tersenyum dan mengangkat senjatanya, untuk sementara menyetel perisai medan gaya dan Remolding Pattern ke daya maksimal.)

column1: Then, in order for the Commander and Captain to break out smoothly, I also have to output with all my might.
column2: Kalau begitu, demi Komandan dan Kapten bisa menerobos dengan mulus, aku juga harus mengeluarkan seluruh tenagaku.
